nodes.label: .`a chapter boss win stores the rolled piece and returns it unsold`()
.`a miniboss win whose roll fails returns null and stores nothing`()
.`a miniboss win whose roll passes stores a piece`()
.`a drop into a full bag is sold into the wallet and not stored`()
.`a full bag with no wallet creates the wallet with the sell price`()
.`the bag of another player does not count`()
